summary: Backend-only public-endpoint testing completed for Payment & Gateway Settings, UPI intents, cash invoice settlement, owner resolution, and requested regressions. Final suite result: 27/29 passed (93.1%); both failures reproduced on retry. Provider entries and all seven field schemas are correct, but the providers response has the wrong top-level shape. Cash settlement accepts and persists overpayment. A critical static/runtime review also found Fernet uses a generated per-process key because ENCRYPTION_KEY is absent, so encrypted gateway secrets will become unreadable after restart and the generated key is printed to logs.

critical.issue: ENCRYPTION_KEY is absent from both backend/.env and the backend process environment; runtime logs confirm EncryptionManager generated a random Fernet key. Gateway secrets saved now cannot be decrypted/masked after a backend restart, and security.py prints the generated key to logs.

Accepts amount_paid above invoice total and persists it (for a total of 200, amount_paid=201 returned 200 with paid status). The existing invoice update API rejects overpayment, so this creates inconsistent and invalid financial records.

minor.issue: Returns {"providers": [...]} instead of the required top-level array. The nested array does contain exactly seven providers with all requested ids, names, countries, and exact field lists.

action_items: Configure a stable ENCRYPTION_KEY before process startup, fail fast when it is missing, and never print generated encryption keys; verify an existing saved secret remains maskable after restart.
Reject amount_paid greater than invoice total in mark-cash-paid before updating MongoDB.
Return SUPPORTED_PROVIDERS directly from GET /api/settings/payment/providers to satisfy the array contract.
Consider setting receipt_sent from the actual send result: send_whatsapp_message returns None when Twilio is unconfigured, but mark-cash-paid currently reports true after any non-throwing no-op.
critical_code_review_comments: security.EncryptionManager generates and logs a Fernet key when ENCRYPTION_KEY is missing. server.py imports security before its own load_dotenv call; the deployed process has no ENCRYPTION_KEY and emitted the generated-key warning, so restart persistence is not safe.
mark_invoice_cash_paid only validates paid > 0 and treats every paid >= total as paid; it needs the same upper-bound invariant already enforced by routes/invoices.py.
mark_invoice_cash_paid sets receipt_sent=True without checking the return value of send_whatsapp_message, whose unconfigured path returns None.
seed_data_creation: Registered one isolated TEST payment doctor, created one isolated front-desk sub-user, seven TEST invoices across Sarah and the isolated owner, and one deletion ticket per full run; fixture teardown removed users, payment settings, invoices, login-limit rows, and deletion tickets. Failure retry used and cleaned a second isolated doctor and invoice.
test_credentials: Used Doctor / Test Professional credentials from /app/memory/test_credentials.md; no credentials were guessed or embedded.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Final suite covers auth guards; fresh defaults; all method transitions; invalid method/VPA/provider/missing fields; UPI intent query and PNG data URL; Razorpay and PhonePe masking plus encrypted-at-rest DB checks; owner resolution through a created front-desk user; gateway deletion; full/partial/receipt/invalid/foreign-owner cash settlement; health/login/appointments/clients/safety/data-deletion/Meta publish regressions. Two deterministic failures are provider response shape and overpayment acceptance. Re-test restart decryptability after ENCRYPTION_KEY is fixed.
rca_of_the_issue: Provider shape: list_providers wraps SUPPORTED_PROVIDERS in a providers object. Overpayment: mark_invoice_cash_paid checks only paid <= 0 and uses paid >= total for status, with no upper bound. Encryption: EncryptionManager falls back to Fernet.generate_key() and logs it when ENCRYPTION_KEY is absent; the running backend emitted this warning, making the cipher process-local rather than restart-stable.
